profile_text.body:
Runway describes itself as building foundational Real-World Intelligence that can understand, simulate and act in the world, with products and services built on top of that intelligence to help individuals and organizations do more. The site says every component, from policy inference and evaluation to synthetic data generation, is powered by GWM-1, which it calls its state-of-the-art General World Model and a step toward universal simulation. It also introduces Solaris as its first Interface World Model, described as real-time AI that generates interactive interfaces frame by frame with no code. The company is promoting a Runway AI Summit on 9/30 in San Francisco, with speakers from DeepMind, NVIDIA and Physical Intelligence.

The company profile lists Runway as a for-profit startup founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York, NY, USA. Its tracked product is Runway, in the video generation and editing category, noted for video generation.

Court records list five cases. David Vance Gardner v. Runway AI, Inc. appears in the District Court, S.D. New York and in the District Court, C.D. California. Businessing LLC v. Runway AI, Inc. and Ace Cam, Inc. v. Runway AI Inc are both listed in the District Court, S.D. New York. Andersen v. Stability AI Ltd. is listed in the U.S. District Court, N.D. California. New York is also recorded as a jurisdiction of legal exposure with a count of 448.
